note: UI Styles is a style-plugin manager. Styles are defined in *.ui_styles.yml files (Drupal YamlDiscovery on the 'ui_styles' key) shipped by an enabled module or theme; a definition's 'options' map keys are the actual CSS classes. Service plugin.manager.ui_styles (StylePluginManager) discovers them; StylePluginManager::addClasses() injects classes into a render array; render/form element type 'ui_styles_styles' renders the grouped selector; selections are stored as the ui_styles.selected_mapping config type {selected, extra}. StylesheetGenerator (route /ui_styles/stylesheet) emits preview CSS. The base module has configure=null and no admin UI. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real plugin discovery: a fixture module ships a *.ui_styles.yml and the agent reads/creates the definition against the live plugin manager.

evals.prompt: In Drupal's UI Styles module, how do I declare a reusable style (a named set of CSS classes) so it shows up in the UI Styles selector? Name the file and the key that holds the CSS classes.
evals.expected_output: Add a <provider>.ui_styles.yml file to an enabled module or theme. Each top-level key is a style plugin id; under it, the 'options' map lists entries where the KEY is the CSS class added and the VALUE is the option label (plus optional label/category/description/weight). Run drush cr; discovery is Drupal\Core\Plugin\Discovery\YamlDiscovery on the 'ui_styles' key.

evals.prompt: Using Drupal UI Styles, which render/form element or plugin-manager method do I use to (a) let a user choose styles in a form and (b) actually add the chosen CSS classes onto a render array?
evals.expected_output: (a) Use the form element '#type' => 'ui_styles_styles' (Drupal\ui_styles\Element\Styles); its value is {selected, extra}. (b) Call \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.ui_styles')->addClasses($build, $selected, $extra) which injects the classes onto the first render element that accepts #attributes.

evals.prompt: UI Styles can generate a CSS file that only contains the rules for its declared style-option classes (used for previews and the CKEditor iframe). What route/path or service provides that generated stylesheet?
evals.expected_output: Route ui_styles.stylesheet at path /ui_styles/stylesheet (StylesheetController::generateStylesheet, permission 'access content'), backed by the service ui_styles.stylesheet_generator (Drupal\ui_styles\Service\StylesheetGenerator::generateStylesheet()).

evals.prompt: An enabled module on this Drupal site defines a UI Styles style plugin. Inspect the live style plugin manager (plugin.manager.ui_styles) and give the plugin id and the CSS class(es) listed in its options.
evals.expected_output: Plugin id ui_styles_eval_shadow (category 'Eval Effects'), options ui-styles-eval-shadow ('Shadow') and ui-styles-eval-border ('Border'). Found via \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.ui_styles')->getDefinition('ui_styles_eval_shadow')->getOptions().

evals.prompt: This site has a UI Styles style plugin with id ui_styles_eval_shadow provided by an enabled module. Under which UI Styles category is it grouped, and how many options does it offer?
evals.expected_output: Category 'Eval Effects' with 2 options (ui-styles-eval-shadow, ui-styles-eval-border). getCategory() returns 'Eval Effects'; getOptions() has two entries.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, define a new UI Styles style plugin with id 'ui_styles_eval_bg' (label 'Eval Background', category 'Eval') that offers a single option whose CSS class is 'ui-styles-eval-bg' (label 'Eval BG'), so that plugin.manager.ui_styles discovers it. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output:
Create a small enabled module (e.g. web/modules/custom/ui_styles_eval_bg) shipping ui_styles_eval_bg.ui_styles.yml with:
  ui_styles_eval_bg:
    label: 'Eval Background'
    category: 'Eval'
    options:
      ui-styles-eval-bg: 'Eval BG'
Enable the module and run drush cr. \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.ui_styles')->hasDefinition('ui_styles_eval_bg') is TRUE and its options include ui-styles-eval-bg.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, define a UI Styles style plugin with id 'ui_styles_eval_spacing' in category 'Eval Spacing' that offers two options: CSS class 'ui-styles-eval-p-1' (label 'Padding 1') and 'ui-styles-eval-p-3' (label 'Padding 3'). Make it discoverable by plugin.manager.ui_styles on the live site.
evals.expected_output:
Ship a <provider>.ui_styles.yml in an enabled module/theme with:
  ui_styles_eval_spacing:
    label: 'Eval Spacing'
    category: 'Eval Spacing'
    options:
      ui-styles-eval-p-1: 'Padding 1'
      ui-styles-eval-p-3: 'Padding 3'
After drush cr, getDefinition('ui_styles_eval_spacing') has category 'Eval Spacing' and both option classes.
